NewsArticle.Title: Connection Upgraded
NewsArticle.Content: Dark Ages connection moves out of the test bay Dark Ages server internet connection is being upgraded to greater bandwidth now; therefore, the server machine is not accessible. The hardware is being physically moved so the server is down for some time. We expect it up by midnight pst 99.04.13, although we cannot directly control the internet service provider's installation performance. Dark Ages server incorporates relay technology; therefore, you do not need a client patch to connect to the new location. That will be done automatically.
